title: Kissed Mediterranean French Egg Plant Gratin
description: A romantic French dish featuring egg plants, pasta-water-emulsion, and Mediterranean-friendly ingredients, cooked in a cataplana vessel to create a jammy and chewy texture.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the eggplant slices with olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper until they are evenly coated.
In a large cataplana vessel, create a layer of eggplant slices.
Spread a layer of tomato paste over the eggplant slices.
Pour some pasta water over the tomato paste layer.
Sprinkle some grated cheese over the pasta water layer.
Repeat the layers until all the ingredients are used up, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Cover the cataplana vessel with a lid and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh basil.
